metadata.gitb:name: [x.keystone-v3.dpp] Validate an uploaded DPP Keystone v3 document (JSON Schema)
metadata.gitb:description: Upload the document as JSON and validate it against DPP Keystone v3, passport (core schema and every sector schema, which apply by contentSpecificationIds; SHACL generated from the ontology), with the publisher's JSON Schemas of release v3 as bundled from DPP Keystone (dpp-keystone.org), DPP Keystone v3 (commit 4d9bd0c9, https://github.com/dpp-keystone-org/DPPKeystoneOrg).

success.default: "The document conforms to DPP Keystone v3 (x.keystone-v3.dpp)."

failure.default: "The document does not conform to DPP Keystone v3 (x.keystone-v3.dpp). The failed step's report lists every finding."
